endorsements.quote: Any approach to implementation should therefore be accompanied by rigorous post-market surveillance and monitoring of relevant outcome parameters such as recall rates, biopsy rates, and cancer detection rates.

Unless AI is used as a standalone tool for imaging evaluation, the final image interpretation responsibility lies with the radiologist, and available AI tools can only be regarded as a tool to assist the radiologist in this task.

unlisted_practices: Conduct post-implementation surveillance studies of regulatory-approved breast ultrasound AI systems to assess their actual value.
Discourage clinical use of large language models in breast imaging without further domain-specific training.
Do not apply AI-CAD developed for digital mammography to synthetic mammograms without proper tuning.
Do not clinically use AI for breast MRI beyond conventional color coding of dynamic data and image registration.

screen.reason: This is a practice guideline and expert consensus/recommendation paper from the European Society of Breast Imaging (EUSOBI) on the deployment, safeguards, and use of AI in breast imaging.
